notes: Paths /stream1, /stream2, /stream3 documented in official Messoa FAQ. Port 554 is the RTSP default; not explicitly stated in the FAQ. Older NVR/fisheye models (e.g. NDR891) used non-standard ports (8554-8558) with codec-specific paths (/h264, /mpeg4, /mjpeg) — those are model-specific exceptions.
